div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The failure this prevents
Prompt an LLM with 'find YouTube policy violations'
and it flags the first-7-seconds profanity rule.
That rule was deleted in July 2025.
Greenlight structurally cannot emit it.

svg.text: Greenlight — Policy-as-Data · why the model cannot invent a rule
